instruction: With the model open in SolveSpace, import seed_ss_gui_02_half_u_bracket.dxf from /home/user/Desktop with File > Import, then continue editing that imported drawing rather than starting from an empty document. Launch SolveSpace from `/usr/bin/solvespace` before importing `seed_ss_gui_02_half_u_bracket.dxf`. Do not use File > Open or launch the DXF as a native SolveSpace file. Complete the partial bracket profile about x=60 into one symmetric U-shaped bracket. The final outer outline must have total width 120, total height 70, slot width 40, and slot depth 30. Add one diameter 8 hole in each side foot, with centers at (20,15) and (100,15). Construction or guide geometry from the seed may be changed or removed unless it is explicitly required above. When the geometry is complete, align the view to the active workplane if needed, then use File > Export 2d View, choose the DXF file type, and save the result as /home/user/Desktop/final_ss_gui_02.dxf. Do not use File > Save As for this final DXF export.
